subject: Night Passage Ash Regent
review: Inspected native front, side, rear and angled clay and material views, plus cross, rain and volley contacts.
Repaired the saved master after initial clay review: replaced boxy shoulders with faceted volumes, split and tapered the rear mantle, and raised the rain gesture above the crown.
Inspected six-frame-per-second decoded unretimed cross, rain and volley playback for preparation, contact and settling; retained the full six-clip 1x movie.
Compared production native and fallback at identical positions and cross warning geometry. The health bar clears the crown; intersecting danger lanes remain visible.
Reviewed 960x600 and 390x244 production views. At narrow scale the blade edge and individual grate bars recede; copper shoulders, dark body and ember center carry the identity.

geometryAgreement.sampling: All 237 authored 30fps frames, 16 vertices per named mesh (528 points/frame); whole-surface native floor/IK audit is separate.

limits: Self-review is not user art approval. Unlit Sovereign and four environment kits remain blockouts.
In-place locomotion has no claim of world-space foot locking at every movement speed; directional locomotion and transition blending remain polish.
Newly loaded mid-action snapshots infer preparation duration when historic enrage timing is unavailable; contact remains tied to the confirmed attack transition.
Six-fps decoded review samples motion; it is not an exhaustive continuous-time anatomical proof.

delegation.ownership: Primary authored native source and integrated/reviewed delivery; two reused workers owned runtime/tests and browser/receipt checks.
delegation.rework: Runtime worker caught initial charge versus cross naming mismatch before native authoring. Native self-review prompted one contour and gesture repair. Both delegated outputs passed integration checks.
delegation.efficiency: Both delegated outputs were used. No measured single-agent time comparison.
